name: Core Banking App — Privilege Granted by Unexpected Administrator
description:
Attacker objective
Grant banking application functions/privileges to an attacker-controlled account (privilege escalation / persistence).

Attack logic
Application privilege grants are performed by a small set of authorised administrators. A grant performed by any other administrator identity is outside the sanctioned set.

Why this detection works
The application audit records the granting admin, the recipient and the function granted, so allowlisting sanctioned granters makes any other grant a high-signal event.

False positives
A newly authorised administrator.

Tuning
Allowlist verified admin IDs; review the source address for an unexpected origin.

Required telemetry
Core Application audit (apps-*, type='Core Application'): GRANTED_BY, USER_ID_GRANTED, FUNCTION_NAME, USR_IPADDRESS.
author: raadabujaish
note:
## Investigation guide
1. GRANTED_BY = the granting admin; USER_ID_GRANTED = the recipient; FUNCTION_NAME = the banking function; USR_IPADDRESS = source.
2. Confirm the grant was authorised and the granter is a sanctioned admin.
